esg.standard_measures.Definition

This class describe parameters to retrieve ESG standart measures data.

Available as lseg.data.content.esg.standard_measures.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    universe: StrStrings,
    start: OptInt = None,
    end: OptInt = None,
    use_field_names_in_headers: bool = False,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
universe StrStrings Yes The Universe parameter allows the user to define the company they want content returned for, ESG content is delivered at the Company Level.
start OptInt No None Start & End parameter allows the user to request the number of Financial Years they would like returned.
end OptInt No None Start & End parameter allows the user to request the number of Financial Years they would like returned.
use_field_names_in_headers bool No False Return field name as column headers for data instead of title

Methods
